Accurate Year-End Accounts for Small to Medium Businesses

Year-end accounts are essential for staying compliant with HMRC and Companies House, but they also offer valuable insights into your business's financial health. At MNA Accounting LTD, we prepare your accounts with precision and clarity — whether you're local or working with us online.

What We Offer

Professional year-end accounts preparation with full compliance support

📊

Annual Financial Statement Preparation

We will compile your profit and loss, balance sheet, and supporting notes in line with UK accounting standards.

📋

HMRC & Companies House Submissions

We will file your accounts and corporation tax return on time, avoiding penalties and ensuring full compliance.

🏢

Tailored Support for Limited Companies & Sole Traders

Whether you're incorporated or self-employed, we adapt our approach to suit your structure.

💡

Clear Explanations & Guidance

We will walk you through your accounts so you understand your numbers and what they mean for your business.
